kolkata-2016.notes: The twelve CodeChef practice pages (KOL16A-KOL16L) do not name the contest; the link to Kolkata 2016 rests on the problem codes. The catalogue has no problem names for this contest; the copies give A 'Playing World War II', B 'Extreme Encoding', C 'Zeroes VII', D 'Men and Horses', E 'Divide Me Please', F 'Precious Stones', G 'Optimal use of Nuclear Power plant', H 'Mr Wireless', I 'Roads', J 'Quentin Tarantino', K 'Chef and Points', L 'Optimal BST Revisited' (letters from the codes).
